tools.name: get_zodiac_sign
tools.description: Western sun sign from a date of birth (year optional, ignored). Returns sign slug, name_en, name_hi, start, end, element, modality, ruler, is_cusp (first or last day), cusp_neighbour, convention 'standard calendar dates', url. Validation error for impossible dates like 02-30. Example input: {"month"

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Score two signs 0-100 with the published rule: element base (same 80; fire-air 85; earth-water 85; fire-earth 45; fire-water 40; earth-air 50; air-water 55), modality same -5 / different +5, no modality adjustment for a sign with itself (same sign = 75), clamp and round; symmetric. Bands: 80+ strong
